journey.name: Explore, Profile Editing, Settings, DM Notifications, Storage, and Developer Mode
journey.description: Tests Explore search, Profile and Edit Profile, Settings toggles (Nearby Sharing, DM Push Notifications), Storage and Retention presets, Developer Mode and BLE Mesh Inspector.

actions.action: Tap the 'Explore' icon in the top bar
Verify that the 'Explore' title, search bar, and 'Nearby People' section are visible
Tap the 'Profile' icon in the top bar
Verify that the 'Profile' title, user stats ('Posts', 'Following', 'Muted'), and 'Edit Profile' button are visible
Tap 'Edit Profile', verify the Edit Profile dialog opens with 'Display Name' and 'Bio', and tap 'Cancel'
Tap the 'Settings' icon in the top bar
Verify that 'Nearby Sharing', 'DM Push Notifications', 'Storage & Retention', and 'Developer Mode' are visible
Tap 'Storage & Retention' and verify Storage Usage, limit presets, and 'Automatic Storage Cleanup' toggle are visible
Tap the 'Back' button to return to Settings
Verify that 'Developer Diagnostics', 'BLE Mesh Telemetry', 'Open BLE Mesh Inspector', and 'Node Identity' appear
Tap 'Open BLE Mesh Inspector' and verify the mesh inspector sheet opens, then dismiss it
Toggle 'Developer Mode' back off and return to Feed
